title: Sipping on tea with Sen no Rikyu each sip welcoming once in a liftetime gift no charge for omotenashi as we must dance in ichigo ichie surrounding me
summary: Sipping on tea with Sen no Rikyu each sip welcoming once in a liftetime gift no charge for omotenashi as we must dance in ichigo ichie surrounding me #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Sipping on tea
with Sen no Rikyu
each sip
welcoming once
in a liftetime gift
no charge for
omotenashi
as we must dance in
ichigo ichie
surrounding me
#poetryport
